baseline.hunk_convention: mixed_hunks[].hunk is the 1-based git hunk index of the file's `git diff -U0` output; kind is the dominant kind of the hunk; secondary kinds are named in note.
baseline.classification_rule: classification = provenance owner of the fork-side delta/content. A files are classified by dominant kind (secondary noted in reason); MIXED is reserved for hand-written M files whose fork-side content spans >=2 kinds.
